description: This C# source file defines serializers, surrogates, and copiers for the ImmutableDictionary<TKey, TValue> type within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It includes classes for serialization, surrogate transformation, and deep copying, specifically tailored to handle immutable dictionaries with custom key and value copying strategies.

classes.name: ImmutableDictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Serializer class for ImmutableDictionary<TKey, TValue> that converts to and from a surrogate representation for serialization purposes.

classes.name: ImmutableDictionarySurrogate<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Surrogate struct used during serialization of ImmutableDictionary, holding a Dictionary<TKey, TValue>.

classes.name: ImmutableDictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Deep copier class for ImmutableDictionary<TKey, TValue>, capable of shallow or deep copying with custom key/value copying strategies.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back into an ImmutableDictionary<TKey, TValue>.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ImmutableDictionary<TKey, TValue> into a surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the ImmutableDictionary, respecting optional key and value copiers.
